senses.zh_definition: 大白：迪士尼《超能陆战队》中的虚构医疗护理机器人角色。
senses.en_definition: The fictional healthcare robot character in Disney's Big Hero 6.
senses.ms_definition: Nama watak robot penjagaan kesihatan fiksyen dalam filem animasi Disney, Big Hero 6.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，规范拼写为 Baymax。此处说明迪士尼动画版本；不把角色名当作马来语中所有护理机器人的通称。输入没有可确认的 DBP 普通词释义。以下搭配为角色相关表达。[Disney 角色资料](https://www.disneystore.com/characters/disney/baymax/)

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam filem Big Hero 6, Baymax ialah robot yang direka untuk membantu menjaga kesihatan manusia.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在《超能陆战队》中，大白是为协助照护人类健康而设计的机器人。
dual_scenarios.en: In Big Hero 6, Baymax is a robot designed to help care for people's health.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak beli patung Baymax tu lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu membeli patung Baymax itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想买那个大白玩偶啦。
dual_scenarios.en: I want to get that Baymax toy.
spoken_features: nak 对应 mahu 或 hendak。
lah 加强表达意愿的语气。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak beli patung Baymax tu lah. Comel sangat!
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu membeli patung Baymax itu kerana patung itu sangat comel.
messages.zh: 我想买那个大白玩偶啦，太可爱了！
messages.en: I want to get that Baymax toy. It's so cute!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah beli satu. Yang kecil tu senang bawa.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membeli satu. Patung yang kecil itu mudah dibawa.
messages.zh: 我已经买了一个，小的那个带着很方便。
messages.en: I've already bought one. The small one is easy to carry around.

etymology.historical_story: In Disney's Big Hero 6, Baymax is an inflatable healthcare companion whose gentle appearance supports his caring role. The character's name also appears on toys and other merchandise, allowing it to travel between languages without becoming an ordinary word for a robot. The cited Disney material establishes the character's identity, but does not explain how the name itself was coined. [Disney character page](https://www.disneystore.com/characters/disney/baymax/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“贝麦克斯”，马上联想白白软软、关心你身体的大白；整个人物形象就是记忆钩子。
